name: Stones of Binding
summary: In Arathi, four Stones of Binding hold Myzrael beneath the ground. A voice from the iridescent shards says the strongest stone needs keys from the other three.

sections.title: Four Stones
sections.body: Across Arathi, four stones keep Myzrael beneath the ground, a voice says. The Stone of Inner Binding is strongest, and keys from the Stones of West, East and Outer Binding can unlock it. Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key. Guardians watch the stones, though someone clever or lucky may find a way to banish them. Carry the keys to the Stone of Inner Binding.

sections.title: At the Inner Stone
sections.body: Myzrael’s voice comes from the stone. The Stones of Binding are open, the shackles are loosening, and freedom draws closer. Myzrael hails you as a noble rescuer.

faq.q: Where does this step come from?
aliases: where to start stones of binding
faq.answer: This step follows The Princess Trapped. Its voice comes from the iridescent shards.

faq.q: What are the four Stones of Binding?
faq.answer: The four are the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding, the Stone of Outer Binding and the strongest, the Stone of Inner Binding.

faq.q: Which keys are needed to unlock the inner stone?
aliases: keys for stone of inner binding
faq.answer: The Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key are gathered from the Stones of West, East and Outer Binding.
Guardians watch over the stones, though a clever or lucky adventurer may find a way to banish them.

faq.q: Where must the keys be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the keys
faq.answer: Carry the keys to the mightiest stone, the Stone of Inner Binding. It must be unlocked before the others will open.

attribution: Classic quest text: Stones of Binding
